description: SD card storage. Files are written under /logs/<device_id>/ (see FILE_FORMAT.md).

bus_width.description: SDIO data lines. 1-bit frees three pins and is still far faster than needed.

freq_khz.description: Bus clock. Lower it for long or breadboard wiring.

self_test.description: Writes a 64 KB test file, reads it back and verifies it, then checks the newest recording starts with the DLOG preamble. Safe while recording. Result: mounted, card_type, total_mb, free_mb, read_write_ok, write_kBps, read_kBps, log_files, newest, newest_bytes, newest_is_dlog, passed.
